script_data.title: Oakhaven's Fate: Prosperity or Purity?
script_data.description: A factory promises hundreds of jobs but will slowly poison the town. What would you choose?
script_data.script: A major corporation offers to build a factory in your struggling hometown, promising hundreds of jobs. You discover the factory will release significant pollution, slowly damaging the environment and public health over decades. Revealing this stops the factory but leaves your town economically depressed.
